Thankfully this was still fairly early in the morning (about 9am at this point), so all in all we were only there for about two hours. From intake onwards, everyone I dealt with had a little chuckle over me getting bit on the lip by my cat. The doctor on call decided to try giving glue a go before sutures, and thankfully it worked out. I was pretty relieved. Although I feel like something from a horror movie (think House of Wax). My lips are stuck together at the corners so I'm not able to open that wide. And it looks pretty gross, I must say. I had to get a tetanus shot, and a course of antibiotics. Did you know cats have venom? I had no idea. After we left the hospital my SO took me to McDonalds to get a coffee frap, which is one of my summer favorites (we don't have Starbucks or Booster Juice or a Tea Shop, which have my actual summer favorites), and dropped me off at home. I felt drained, so I laid down on top of my sheets, just staring at the ceiling for a few minutes. When WHO COMES SAUNTERING IN. Pink. She jumped up and cuddled up next to me. Ohhhhh no miss muffet. I put her down. She stared up at me, probably not understanding, then waddled off. Hmph.

Slept for about five hours after that. I think the tetanus shot made me extra-tired, as I read online that may be one of the side effects. Just hoping it heals up well and doesn't scar too bad, as I already have self-esteem issues and rarely leave the house on my own. Now I feel especially gross.
